Zulu: Ngowezi-2019, abacwaningi babheka ukuthi kwenzekani kumasosha omzimba ngalinye, njengama-T-cell, lapho i-HIV iqala ukungena emzimbeni.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar 2019, masu bincike sun kalli abin da yake faruwa a cikin ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki guda ɗaya, kamar ƙwayoyin T, a lokacin da ƙwayar cutar HIV ta fara shiga jiki.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2019, banyakišiši ba ile ba lebelela gore go direga eng ka gare ga disele tša mašole a mmele, tša go swana le T-cells, ge HIV e thoma go tsena mmeleng.
Amharic: በ2019፣ ተመራማሪዎች ኤችአይቪ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ሰውነት ሲገባ፣ እንደ ቲ-ህዋሳት ያሉ፣ የሰው በሽታ ተከላካይ ህዋሳት ውስጥ ምን እንደሚፈጠር ተመልክተዋል።

English: By understanding what exactly happens when this virus first enters the body, researchers might be able to design better treatments and vaccines to prevent infection.
Luganda: Okutegeera obulungi ku kiki ddala ekibaawo ng’akawuka kye kajje kayingire mu mubiri, abanoonyereza bayinza okusobola obulungi okukola ku bujjanjabi n’eddagala erigema okuziyiza obulwadde obwo.
Yoruba: Nípa òye ohun tó máa ń ṣẹlẹ̀ tí fáírọ́ọ̀sì bá kọ́kọ́ wọnú àgó ara, àwọn aṣèwádìí lè ṣẹ̀dá ìtọ́jú tó dára àti àwọn òògùn adènà láti kojú ìkóràn náà.
Zulu: Ngokuqonda ukuthi kwenzekani ngempela lapho leli gciwane liqala ukungena emzimbeni, abacwaningi bangase bakwazi ukwakha izindlela zokwelapha ezingcono kanye nemithi yokugoma ukuvimbela ukutheleleka.
Hausa: Ta hanyar fahimtar ainihin abin da yake faruwa a lokacin da wannan ƙwayar cutar ta fara shiga cikin jiki, masu bincike za su iya tsara magunguna mafi kyau da maganin rigakafi don hana kamuwa da cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ka go kwešiša gore gabotse go direga eng ge baerase ye e tsena meleng, banyakišiši ba ka kgona go hlama dikalafo tše kaone le meento ya go thibela phetetšo.
Amharic: ይህ ቫይረስ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ሰውነት ሲገባ በትክክል ምን እንደሚፈጠር በመረዳት፣ ተመራማሪዎች ኢንፌክሽኑን ለመከላከል የተሻሉ ህክምናዎችን እና ክትባቶችን ለመንደፍ ይችሉ ይሆናል።

English: In this study, researchers studied blood samples from a few people from the Females Rising through Education, Support and Health (FRESH) group.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonyereza ku sampolo z’omusaayi okuva ku bantu abatono okuva mu Females Rising through Education, Support n’ekibiina kya Health (FRESH).
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣiṣẹ́ ìwádìí lórí àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn èèyàn díẹ̀ láti inú ẹgbẹ́ àwọn Obìnrin tó ń Lọ síwájú nípa Ètò-ẹ̀kọ, Àtìlẹ́yìn àti Ètò-ìlera (FRESH).
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bacwaninge amasampula egazi kubantu abambalwa beqembu le-Females Rising through Education, Support and Health ( FRESH).
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun yi nazarin samfuran jini daga wasu mutane kaɗan daga ƙungiyar Mata Masu Tasowa ta Hanyar Ilimi da Tallafawa da kuma Lafiya (FRESH).
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba nyakišišitše ka ga disampole tša madi go tšwa go batho ba mmalwa go tšwa go Basadi mabapi le sehlpha sa Thuto, Thekgo le Maphelo (FRESH).
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎች ከሴቶች እድገት በትምህርት፣ ድጋፍ እና ጤና (FRESH) ቡድን ውስጥ የተወሰዱ የተወሰኑ ሰዎች የደም ናሙናዎችን አጥንተዋል።

English: These were women aged 18-24 years, who were at a high risk of getting HIV.
Luganda: Bano baali bakyala abali wakati w’emyaka 18-24 abaali mu bulabe obwamaanyi okukwatibwa HIV.
Yoruba: N obìnrin wọ̀nyìí jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 18-24, tó wà nínú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ewu láti ní HIV.
Zulu: Laba kwakungabesifazane abaneminyaka eli-18-24 ubudala, ababesengozini enkulu yokuthola i-HIV.
Hausa: Waɗannan mata ne masu shekaru 18 zuwa 24, waɗanda suke cikin haɗarin kamuwa da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ba ke basadi ba mengwaga ye 18-24, bao ba bego ba le kotsing ya godimo ya go fetelwa ke HIV.
Amharic: እነዚህ በኤችአይቪ የመያዝ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ የሆነ፣ ከ18-24 አመት የሆናቸው ሴቶች ነበሩ።

English: They used a technique called “single-cell RNA-sequencing” to see which genes had been turned on in certain immune cells during the early HIV infection stage.
Luganda: Baakozesa akakodyo akayitibwa “single-cell RNA-sequencing” okusobola okulaba bulagabutonde ki obwatandika okubaako kye bukola mu butaffaali obumu obusibage mu kiseera kya HIV ng’aleese obulwadde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lo ìlànà kan tí a ń pè ní "ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé RNA onísẹ́ẹ̀lì-kan" láti wo gíìnì tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ nínú àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ní àjẹsára ní pàtó nígbà ìpele àkọ́kọ́ inú ìkóràn HIV.
Zulu: Basebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi “single-cell RNA-sequencing” ukuze babone ukuthi yiziphi izakhi zofuzo ezazivulwe kumasosha athile omzimba ngesikhathi sokutheleleka nge-HIV.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da wata dabara da ake kira “Jerin RNA na Sel Ɗaya” don ganin waɗanne ƙwayoyin gado da aka kunna a cikin wasu ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki a farkon lokacin kamuwa da ƙwayar cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše mkgwa wo o bitšwago “tatelanyo ya RNA ya sele e tee” go bona gore ke ditšini dife tše di goteditšwego ka go disele tše itšego tša mašole a mmele ka nakong ya mathomo a phetetšo ya HIV.
Amharic: በመጀመሪያ የኤችአይቪ ኢንፌክሽን ደረጃ ላይ የትኞቹ ጂኖች በተወሰኑ የበሽታ ተከላካይ ሕዋሳት ውስጥ እንደበሩ ለማየት "ነጠላ-ህዋስ አርኤንኤ-ድርደራ" የተባለ ዘዴን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: They looked specifically at white blood cells, monocytes, T-cells , CD4+ cells, and natural killer (NK) cells.
Luganda: Okusinga ennyo baatunuulira butaffaali obweru, monocytes, T-cells , CD4+ cells n’obutaffaali bu-natural killer (NK).
Yoruba: Wọ́n wo àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ń tako ìkóràn àti oríṣiríṣi ààrùn ní pàtó, sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ń ṣètọ́jú èṣe tó sì ń tako ìkóràn, sẹ́ẹ̀lì-T, sẹ́ẹ̀lì CD4+, àti sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ń dènà ìju àti àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ní fáírọ́ọ̀sì (NK).
Zulu: Babheka ngokukhethekile amasosha egazi amhlophe, ama-monocyte, T-cells, CD4+ cells, kanye nombulali wemvelo (NK) wamasosha.
Hausa: Sun kalli fararen ƙwayar jini na musamman da fararen ƙwayar da T-cell da CD4+ cell da kuma ƙwayoyin kisa na halitta (NK).
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lebelela kudu diselemadi tše tšhweu, dimonosaete, T-cells , disele tša CD4+, le disele tša polao ya tlhago (NK).
Amharic: በተለይም ነጭ የደም ሴሎችን፣ ሞኖሳይቶችን፣ ቲ-ህዋሳትን፣ ሲዲ4+ ህዋሳትን፣ እና የተፈጥሮ ገዳይ (NK) ህዋሳትን ይመለከቱ ነበር።

English: They found that during the viral infection, there are less T-cells but more monocytes and NK cells.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti mu kiseera ky’okulwala akawuka, wabeerawo T-cells ntono naye ate obutaffaali monocytes ne NK bwo bweyongera.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí pé nígbà ìkóràn tó ń tàn kiri, àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì-T ò fi bẹ́ẹ̀ pọ̀ àmọ́ àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ń ṣètọ́jú èṣe tó sì ń tako ìkóràn àti sẹ́ẹ̀lì NK máa ń pọ̀.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi ngesikhathi sokutheleleka ngegciwane, kukhona ama-T-cell amancane kodwa ama-monocyte amaningi kanye namasosha e-NK.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa yayin kamuwa da ƙwayar cuta, akwai ƙananan T-cells amma akwai ƙarin fararen ƙwayoyin jini da kuma ƙwayoyin NK.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore ka nakong ya phetetšo ya dibaerase, tšona ke T-cells tše mmalwa eupša dimonosaete tše ntši le disele tša NK.
Amharic: በቫይረሱ ኢንፌክሽን ወቅት፣ ያነሱ ቲ-ህዋሳት፣ ነገር ግን ብዙ ሞኖሳይቶች እና NK ህዋሳት አሉ።

English: The women had high amounts of the virus in their blood, but low amounts of CD4+ cells, or immune cells.
Luganda: Abakazi baalina obuwuka bungi ddala mu musaayi gwabwe, naye ate CD4+ cells zo zaali ntono oba obutaffaali obusibage.
Yoruba: Àwọn obìnrin ní ìpele fáírọ́ọ̀sì tó ga nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ wọn, ṣùgbọ́n ìpele kékeré sẹ́ẹ̀lì CD4+, tàbí sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ní àjẹsára.
Zulu: Abesifazane babenenani eliphezulu legciwane egazini labo, kodwa inani eliphansi lamasosha e-CD4+, noma amasosha omzimba.
Hausa: Matan suna da yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jininsu, amma ƙananan ƙwayoyin CD4+, ko ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki.
Northern Sotho: Basadi ba bile le tekano ya godimo ya baerase ka mading a bona, eupša le tekano ya fase ya disele tša CD4+, goba disele tša mašole a mmele.
Amharic: ሴቶቹ በደማቸው ውስጥ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ቫይረስ ነበራቸው፣ ነገር ግን አነስተኛ መጠን ያለው የሲዲ4+ ህዋሳት፣ ወይም የበሽታ ተከላካይ ሕዋሳት ነበራቸው።

English: They found that the different cell types had their own set of genes that are turned on at certain times during HIV infection.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti ebika by’obutaffali eby’enjawulo bwalina ekika ky’obulagabutonde obwabyo obutanula okukola mu kiseera ekimu eky’Obulwadde bwa HIV.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i pé àwọn oríṣiríṣi irú sẹ́ẹ̀lì ló ní seeti gíìnì wọn tó máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní ẹ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan nígbà ìkóràn HIV.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zamasosha zinenhlobo yazo yezakhi zofuzo ezivulwa ngezikhathi ezithile ngesikhathi sokutheleleka nge-HIV.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa nau’o’in tantanin halitta daban-daban suna da nasu nau'in ƙwayoyin gafon da ake kunnawa a wasu lokuta a yayin kamuwa da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore mehuta ye e fapanego ya disele e be e na le disete tša yona tša ditšini tšeo di gotetšwago dinakong tše dingwe ka nakong ya phetetšo ya HIV.
Amharic: የተለያዩ የሕዋስ ዓይነቶች በኤችአይቪ ኢንፌክሽን ወቅት በተወሰኑ ጊዜያት የሚበሩ የራሳቸው ጂኖች እንዳሏቸው ደርሰውበታል።

English: Interferon type 1 (IFN) is an antiviral protein released by the host (the infected patient) to fight off viruses.
Luganda: Interferon type 1 (IFN) kika kya antiviral protein ekifulumizibwa ekiterekakawuka (omuntu alwadde) to okulwanyisa akawuka.
Yoruba: Irú Interferone 1 (IFN) jẹ́ purotéènì tó ń tako ìtànkálẹ̀ ààrùn tí olùgbàlejò fi sílẹ̀ (aláìsàn tó ní ìkóràn) láti gbógun ti awon fáírọ́ọ̀sì.
Zulu: I-Interferon Type 1 (IFN) iwumsoco olwa namagciwane ekhishwa umamukeli (isiguli esithelelekile) ukuze silwe namagciwane.
Hausa: Nau’in Interferon 1 (IFN) furotin ne na rigakafin ƙwayar cuta wanda mai cuta (majinyacin da ya kamu da cutar) ya fitar domin yaƙar ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Interferon ya mohuta wa 1 (IFN) ke phrotheine ya twantšho ya dibaerase ye e lokollwago ke mong (molwetši yo a feteditšwego) go lwantšha dibaerase.
Amharic: ኢንተርፌሮን ዓይነት 1 (IFN) ቫይረሶችን ለመዋጋት በተሸካሚው (በተበከለው በሽተኛ) የተለቀቀ የፀረ-ቫይረስ ፕሮቲን ነው።

English: They found that in all patients, the IFN response to high levels of viruses in the blood was strong.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti mu balwadde bonna, okwanukula kwa IFN eri obuwuka obwamaanyi mu maanyi mu musaayi kwali kwamaanyi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i pé láàárín gbogbo àwọn aláìsàn, ìdáhùn IFN sí ìpele gíga fáírọ́ọ̀sì inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ lágbára.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi kuzo zonke iziguli, impendulo ye-IFN emazingeni aphezulu amagciwane egazini yayinamandla.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa a cikin duka marasa lafiya, amsawar IFN ga manyan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jini yana da ƙarfi.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore go balwetši ka moka, phetolo ya IFN go maemo a godimo a dibaerase ka mading e bile maatla.
Amharic: በሁሉም ታካሚዎች ውስጥ፣ በደም ውስጥ ለሚገኙ ከፍተኛ መጠን ላላቸው ቫይረሶች የIFN ምላሽ ጠንካራ እንደሆነ ደርሰውበታል።

English: They found that some genes are active a month after infection.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti obulagabutonde obumu butanula okukola mu mwezi gumu oluvannyuma lw’okulwala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i pé àwọn gíìnì kọ̀ọ̀kan tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti oṣù kan lẹ́yìn ìkóràn.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi ezinye izakhi zofuzo ziyasebenza ngemva kwenyanga ukutheleleka.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa wasu ƙwayoyin gado suna aiki wata ɗaya bayan kamuwa da cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore ditšini tše dingwe di a šoma kgwedi ka morago ga phetetšo.
Amharic: አንዳንድ ጂኖች በኢንፌክሽኑ አንድ ወር በኋላ ንቁ እንደሆኑ ደርሰውበታል።

English: In the different cell types, the set of genes were not the same but they had similar functions.
Luganda: Mu bika by’obutaffaali eby’enjawulo, obubinja bw’obulagabutonde tebwali bwebumu naye bwalina emirimu gyegimu.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn oríṣiríṣi irú sẹ́ẹ̀lì, sẹ́ẹ̀tì àwọn gíìnì ò jẹ́ ìkan náà àmọ́ wọ́n ń ṣe iṣẹ́ tó fara pẹ́ ara wọn.
Zulu: Ezinhlotsheni ezihlukene zamasosha omzimba, iqoqo lezakhi zofuzo zazingafani kodwa zazinemisebenzi efanayo.
Hausa: A cikin nau’o’in tantanin halitta daban-daban, saitin ƙwayoyin gado ba iri ɗaya ba ne, amma suna da ayyuka iri ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Ka go mehuta ya disele ye e fapafapanego, sete ya ditšini e be e sa swane eupša ebe e na le mešomo ye e swanago.
Amharic: በተለያዩ የሕዋስ ዓይነቶች ውስጥ፣ የጂኖች ስብስብ ተመሳሳይ አይደለም ነገር ግን ተመሳሳይ ተግባራት ነበራቸው።

English: They noted that CD4+ cells are active before peak viral load, which is the amount of HIV in the blood, 3-4 weeks after infection.
Luganda: Baakiraba nti CD4+ cells buba bukola ng’akawuka tekannayingiwa kutuuka ku ntikko, bwe bungi bwa HIV mu mubiri, mu kiseera kya wiiki 3-4 ng’omaze okulwala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i pé àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì CD4+ ń ṣiṣẹ́ ṣáájú iye ààrùn HIV tí wọ́n bá rí nínú ara, èyí tó jẹ́ ọ̀sẹ̀ 3-4 lẹ́yìn ìkóràn.
Zulu: Baphawule ukuthi amasosha omzimba e-CD4+ asebenza ngaphambi komthamo wegciwane egazini, okuyinani le-HIV egazini, emasontweni ama-3-4 ngemva kokutheleleka.
Hausa: Sun lura cewa ƙwayoyin CD4 + suna aiki kafin tarin ƙwayar cuta mafi girma, wanda shi ne adadin HIV a cikin jini, makonni 3 zuwa 4 bayan kamuwa da cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile gore disele tša CD4+ di šoma pele ga ge morwalo wa dibaerase o eba godimo, e lego tekano ya HIV ka mading, dibeke tše 3-4 ka morago ga phetetšo.
Amharic: የሲዲ4+ ህዋሶች ከከፍተኛ የቫይረስ ጭነት በፊት ንቁ መሆናቸውን ጠቁመዋል፣ ይህም በደም ውስጥ ያለው የኤችአይቪ መጠን፣ ከኢንፌክሽኑ 3-4 ሳምንታት በኋላ ነው።

English: T cells are active 2-3 weeks around peak viral load, and NK and monocytes are active throughout the first month of infection.
Luganda: Ate T cells bwo buba bukola mu wiiki 2-3 mu kiseera ky’akawuka okuyingiwala, ate NK ne monocytes buba bukola mu kiseera ky’omwezi ogusooka gwonna ogw’obulwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì T maa ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní àárín ọ̀sẹ̀ 2-3 iye àrùn tí wọ́n bá rí nínú ara, àti NK àti mùdùnmúdùn máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní gbogbo oṣù àkọ́kọ́ ìkóràn.
Zulu: Ama-T cell asebenza emavikini ama-2-3 ezungeze inani eliphakeme legciwane, futhi i-NK kanye nama-monocyte asebenza kuyo yonke inyanga yokuqala yokutheleleka.
Hausa: Ƙwayoyin T suna aiki makonni 2 zuwa 3 a kusa da mafi girman nauyin ƙwayar cutar, kuma NK da fararen ƙwayoyin jini suna aiki a cikin watan farko na kamuwa da cutar.
Northern Sotho: T cells di šoma dibeke tše 2-3 ka nakong ya morwalo wa dibaerase wa godimo, gomme NK le dimonosaete di šoma kgwedi ya mathomo ka moka ya phetetšo.
Amharic: ቲ ህዋሳት በቫይረስ ጭነት ከ2-3 ሳምንታት አካባቢ ውስጥ ንቁ ናቸው፣ እና NK እና ሞኖሳይተስ በኢንፌክሽኑ ​​የመጀመሪያ ወር ውስጥ ንቁ ናቸው።

English: They found that the 2 patients who had low levels of the virus in the blood after 2.75 years, had highly active genes in monocyte cells.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti abalwadde 2 abaalina ekigero ky’akawuka ekitono mu musaayi oluvannyuma lw’emyaka 2.75, baalina obulagabutonde obukola ennyo mu monocyte cells.
Yoruba: Won rí i pé àwọn aláìsàn 2 tó ní ìpele kékeré fáírọ́ọ̀sì inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ lẹ́yìn ọdún 2.75, ní àwọn gíìnì tó pọ̀ tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ nínú sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó wà nínú mùdùnmúdùn inú egungun.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi iziguli ezi-2 ezazinamazinga aphansi egciwane egazini ngemva kweminyaka emi-2.75, zinezakhi zofuzo ezisebenza kakhulu kumaseli e-monocyte.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa marasa lafiya guda 2 da suke da ƙananan matakan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jini bayan shekaru 2.75, suna da ƙwayoyin gado masu aiki sosai a cikin ƙwayoyin monocyte.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore balwetši ba 2 bao ba bego ba na le maemo a fase a baerase ka mading ka morago ga mengwaga ye 2.75, ba bile le ditšini tše di šomago ka mafolofolo kudu ka go disele tša monosaete.
Amharic: ከ2.75 ዓመታት በኋላ በደም ውስጥ ያለው የቫይረሱ ዝቅተኛ መጠን ያላቸው 2 ታካሚዎች፣ በሞኖሳይት ህዋሳት ውስጥ በጣም ንቁ የሆኑ ጂኖች እንዳላቸው ደርሰውበታል።

English: Because some T cells are HIV-specific, the researchers looked at the cells to see how patients controlled the infection over the long-term.
Luganda: Olw’okuba nti T cells ezimu zigendera ku kika kya HIV, abanoonyereza baatunuulira obutaffaali okulaba abalwadde nga bwe bafuga obulwadde mu kiseera ekiwanvu.
Yoruba: Torí àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì T tó ní àrùn-ìsọdọ̀le-àjẹsára ní pàtó, àwọn aṣèwádìí wo àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì láti wo bí àwọn aláìsàn ti ń kápá ìkóràn náà lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ - pípẹ́.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi amanye ama-T cell aqondene ne-HIV, abacwaningi babheke amasosha ukuze babone ukuthi iziguli zilawuleka kanjani ukutheleleka esikhathini eside.
Hausa: Saboda wasu ƙwayoyin T suna da ƙayyadaddun ƙwayar cutar HIV, masu binciken sun kalli sel don ganin yadda marasa lafiya suke kulawa da kamuwa da cuta na tsawon lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge di-T cells tše dingwe di na le HIV, banyakišiši ba lekotše disele go bona ka fao balwetši ba laotšego phetetšo mo lebakeng le letelele.
Amharic: አንዳንድ የቲ ህዋሳት ኤችአይቪ-ተኮር በመሆናቸው፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ ታካሚዎች ለረጅም ጊዜ ኢንፌክሽኑን እንዴት እንደሚቆጣጠሩት ለመረዳት ህዋሳቱን ተመልክተዋል።

English: They noticed that the two patients who had controlled the infection long-term had higher levels of specific T cells.
Luganda: Baakikenga nti abalwadde ababiri abaali bafuze akawuka mu kiseera ekiwanvu baalina ekigero kya T cells ekyawagguluko.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àkíyèsí wí pé àwọn aláìsàn méjì tó ti ṣe àkóso ìkóràn ọlọ́jọ́-pípẹ́ ní ìpele sẹ́ẹ̀lì T tó ga ní pàtó.
Zulu: Baqaphela ukuthi iziguli ezimbili ezazilawule ukutheleleka isikhathi eside zazinamazinga aphezulu ama-T cell athile.
Hausa: Sun lura cewa marasa lafiya biyu da suka kula da kamuwa da cutar na tsawon lokaci suna da matakan girma na takamaiman ƙwayoyin T.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile gore balwetši ba babedi bao phetetšo ya bona e bego e laotšwe lebaka le letelele ba bile le maemo a godimo a T cells tše itšego.
Amharic: ኢንፌክሽኑን ለረጅም ጊዜ የተቆጣጠሩት ሁለቱ ታካሚዎች የተለዩ የቲ ህዋሳት ከፍተኛ ደረጃዎች እንዳላቸው አስተውለዋል።

English: These results show what happens in a person’s cells during the early infection stage of HIV.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa bino biraga ekibaawo mu butaffaali bw’omuntu mu kiseera ky’okukwatibwa HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì wọ̀nyìí ṣàfihàn ohun tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ nínú sẹ́ẹ̀lì èèyàn ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìpele ìkóràn àrùn-ìsọdọ̀le-àjẹsára.
Zulu: Le miphumela ikhombisa ukuthi kwenzekani kumasosha omuntu ngesikhathi sokuqala sokutheleleka nge-HIV.
Hausa: Waɗannan sakamakon sun nuna abin da yake faruwa a cikin ƙwayoyin jikin mutum a lokacin farkon kamuwa da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tše di laetša seo se diregago ka gare ga disele tša motho ka nakong ya mathomong a phetetšo ya HIV.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ በመጀመሪያ ደረጃ የኤችአይቪ ኢንፌክሽን ወቅት በሰው ህዋሳት ውስጥ ምን እንደተፈጠረ አሳይተዋል።

English: Other researchers can now use this information to further build our understanding of HIV immunity on a cellular level so that treatments and vaccines can be better targeted.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abalala kati basobola okukozesa obubaka okwongera okuzimba okutegeera kwaffe okw’obusibage bwa HIV ku mutendera gw’obutaffaali kibe nti obujjanjabi n’eddagala erigema lisobole okutunuulirwa obulungiko.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí mìíràn lè fi àlàyé yìí láti fi túbọ̀ kọ́ ìmọ̀ wa nípa àjẹ́sára àrùn-ìsọdọ̀lẹ ní ti ìpele onísẹ́ẹ̀lì kí a lè fojú sùnùkùn wo ìtọ́jú àti abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára dáada.
Zulu: Abanye abacwaningi sebengakwazi manje ukusebenzisa lolu lwazi ukuze baqhubeke nokwakha ukuqonda kwethu ukungatheleleki kwe-HIV ezingeni lamasosha ukuze ukwelashwa nemithi yokugoma kuqondiswe kangcono.
Hausa: Wasu masu bincike yanzu za su iya amfani da wannan bayanin don ƙara haɓaka fahimtarmu game da garkuwar cutar HIV a kan matakin salula ta yadda za a iya yin niyya mafi kyau don jiyya da kuma alluran rigakafi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bangwe bjale ba ka šomiša tshedimošo ye go tšwela pele go bopa kwešišo ya boitšhireletšo go HIV ga maemo a disele gore dikalafo le meento e kgone go nepišwa bokaone.
Amharic: ሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች አሁን ይህንን መረጃ ተጠቅመው ስለ ኤችአይቪ መከላከያ ያለንን ግንዛቤ በህዋሳዊ ደረጃ በማጎልበት ህክምናዎች እና ክትባቶች በተሻለ ሁኔታ ኢላማ እንዲሆኑ ማድረግ ይችላሉ።

English: The authors of this study were from various countries in Africa, the USA and Germany.
Luganda: Abawandiisi b’okunoonyereza kuno baali bava mu nsi ez’enjawulo mu Afirika, USA ne Bugirimaani.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí wá láti onírúurú orílẹ̀èdè ní ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀, USA àti Jámánì.
Zulu: Ababhali balolu cwaningo bebeqhamuka emazweni ahlukene e-Afrika, e-USA nase-Germany.
Hausa: Marubutan wannan binciken sun fito ne daga ƙasashe daban-daban na Afirka da USA da kuma Jamus.
Northern Sotho: Bangadi ba dinyakišišo tše ba be ba etšwa ka dinageng tša mehutahuta tša Afrika, USA le Germany.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ጸሃፊዎች ከተለያዩ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ካሉ ሃገሮች፣ ከዮኤስኤ እና ከጀርመን ነበሩ።
